create_subclass_of_InstanceBase: create a subclass of InstanceBase that implements get_instance_id and uses dataclass_json serialization
implement_get_instance_id: implement the abstract get_instance_id method in a subclass of InstanceBase to return a unique string identifier
serialize_instance_to_json: serialize an InstanceBase subclass instance to a JSON schema string using the dumps_schema method
deserialize_instance_from_json: deserialize a JSON schema string back into an InstanceBase subclass instance using the loads_schema class method
use_DataclassMutabilityMixin: use the DataclassMutabilityMixin to control mutability of an InstanceBase subclass dataclass instance
